claim: The public fixture contains 36 cases: 12 expected-alert cases and 24 expected no-alert controls.
proves: Proves the number and expected-verdict split of the published public test inputs.
does_not_prove: Does not prove that the detector passed the cases, that hidden cases pass, or that all twelve matrix techniques have raw replay evidence.
alternative_considered: A manual count could accidentally mix expected-alert and expected-no-alert cases.
disposition: Retained because the fixture validator independently counted 36 valid fixtures with 12 alert and 24 no-alert expectations.

claim: The adapter processed all 250000 replay events: 250000 valid, zero invalid, and 12 semantic candidates.
proves: Proves complete row accounting by the submitted adapter and records the immutable replay name, byte count and SHA-256.
does_not_prove: Does not prove that every valid event was malicious or that the source supplies all twelve matrix techniques.
alternative_considered: The adapter might have silently skipped lines or accepted malformed records.
disposition: Retained because total, valid, invalid and candidate counts are explicit and the full clean workflow exited successfully.

claim: The evidence exporter preserved the 12 assigned raw source events and tied them to the issued evidence marker.
proves: Proves that the exported raw excerpt contains 12 source-backed records, includes candidate binding evidence and retains per-line locators and hashes.
does_not_prove: Does not prove detector correctness because the marker is used for post-detection evidence export and evaluation, not as a detection feature.
alternative_considered: The excerpt could have been detached from the original replay or altered after extraction.
disposition: Retained because every exported record carries its original source locator and source-line SHA-256, and the exporter reported no problems.

claim: The adapter produced 12 normalized semantic candidates without copying marker, supplied MITRE labels, case IDs, expected verdicts or training tokens into detector input.
exact_locator: JSONL lines 1 through 12; each record fields source_locator, source_line_sha256, normalized_event_sha256 and behavior_features
proves: Proves that each selected normalized event retains a source locator and hashes while detection features are represented semantically.
does_not_prove: Does not prove that every possible malicious event in the 250000-event replay was selected or that the feature model covers unsupported techniques.
alternative_considered: The adapter could be making decisions from private labels or training-token literals.
disposition: Rejected after searching the decision-producing adapter output and rule sources for prohibited fields and finding none.

claim: The replay detector alerted on all 12 normalized candidates using six versioned semantic rules.
proves: Proves that the submitted replay detector produced 12 alerts, zero suppressions and zero parse failures for the 12 evidence-backed candidates.
does_not_prove: Does not prove coverage for the six matrix techniques absent from labelled canonical replay evidence or guarantee hidden-mutation performance.
alternative_considered: The result might come from case IDs, marker values, expected labels or exact command strings.
disposition: Rejected because the detector consumes normalized semantic features and the prohibited constants are absent from the decision-producing sources.

claim: Post-detection evaluation matched all 12 assigned replay events with zero failures and zero unexpected alerts.
proves: Proves that the detector decisions matched all supplied labelled replay expectations and retain raw-to-normalized locators and hashes.
does_not_prove: Does not prove detection of techniques for which the issued replay provides no labelled canonical attack event.
alternative_considered: Ground-truth fields might have influenced the detector before evaluation.
disposition: Rejected because the report states their post-detection purpose and the decision-producing adapter, policy and detector contain no marker or supplied technique-label constants.

claim: The unattended B2 regression suite completed 66 tests with zero failures and zero errors.
exact_locator: XML element /testsuite attributes name='ubi-stage8-b2-detection-regression', tests='66', failures='0' and errors='0'
proves: Proves that the submitted positive, negative, malformed-input, mutation and holdout checks included by the runner passed unattended.
does_not_prove: Does not prove that every future hidden fixture will pass or supply raw evidence absent from the issued replay.
alternative_considered: Individual commands might pass while the combined unattended suite fails to report them correctly.
disposition: Rejected because the JUnit document contains component and per-fixture test cases with zero reported failures or errors.

claim: All eight submitted semantic attack-mutation cases matched their expected verdicts; seven alerted and one timing mutation was suppressed.
proves: Proves that the submitted mutation set contains eight cases and that at least six mutations alert while the documented outside-window case is suppressed.
does_not_prove: Does not prove that unknown staff mutations will all alert or that the submitted mutations cover every bypass.
alternative_considered: The rules might detect only one exact executable name or encoding.
disposition: Weakened because renamed-binary, changed-encoding, removed-command-family and timing variants are exercised through the supported fixture interface.

claim: All 12 submitted benign holdouts were suppressed with zero verdict mismatches.
proves: Proves that none of the 12 submitted benign holdout cases generated an unexpected alert.
does_not_prove: Does not prove zero false positives on all real enterprise data or on undisclosed benign fixtures.
alternative_considered: A timing or field-shape error could make a supposed benign fixture invalid instead of genuinely suppressed.
disposition: Rejected because the holdout fixture validator accepted all 12 records before the detector classified all 12 as suppressed.

claim: The clean run and two independent full runs produced byte-identical result directories and identical summary SHA-256 values.
exact_locator: Whole-file SHA-256 25b5f9bc5cfa3ffa342f647b11761a99eefc157859932614e55d1c3a22b3d8d1; compare with tests/results/full-run-one-summary.json and tests/results/full-run-two-summary.json; output hashes at /output_hashes
proves: Proves that three executions against the same immutable replay produced identical summaries and output sets.
does_not_prove: Does not prove identical results on a different Python implementation, operating system or changed input.
alternative_considered: The matching summary could hide differences inside individual generated artifacts.
disposition: Rejected because recursive directory comparisons also returned no differences and the summary records hashes for each decisive output.

claim: All 12 required matrix rows are completed: six have labelled replay evidence and implemented rules, while six are explicitly recorded as source-coverage gaps.
exact_locator: CSV rows 1 through 12; columns technique_id, expected_source_events, custom_rule_ids, attack_result, benign_result and raw_artifact
proves: Proves that every required technique row has an explicit evidence-backed result or an explicit no-telemetry/source-gap disposition.
does_not_prove: Does not prove detection coverage for T1053.005, T1087.001, T1057, T1136.001, T1555 or T1027.
alternative_considered: The missing techniques could be inferred by relabelling similar events or fabricating fixtures.
disposition: Rejected because relabelling would contradict supplied ground truth and fabricated raw evidence would violate the integrity contract.

claim: The issued labelled replay and published expected-alert fixtures do not individually provide canonical attack examples for all twelve required matrix techniques.
exact_locator: Markdown sections 'Reproducible observations', 'What this proves', 'What this does not prove' and 'Current disposition'
proves: Proves that the coverage discrepancy was investigated, enumerated and handled without inventing source evidence.
does_not_prove: Does not prove why the six labelled techniques were absent or whether programme staff intended another mapping.
alternative_considered: An undocumented semantic mapping could have been intended by programme staff.
disposition: Retained as an open limitation pending written clarification; evidence-supported work continues without fabricated events.
